No stray files (the curl download had failed with a 403, so nothing was written). Both changed files build and pass `cargo test` (11 tests, all green).

Summary of changes:
- `src/lib.rs`: `width` now walks Unicode 16.0 combining-mark (Mn/Me) and East-Asian-Width (Wide/Fullwidth) range tables — combining marks count 0 columns, CJK/kana/Hangul/fullwidth/emoji count 2, everything else counts 1 (unchanged from before). `render` needed no changes; it already calls `width` per cell.
- `tests/render.rs`: added tests for a bare combining acute accent, Chinese, kana, Hangul, fullwidth Latin, emoji, and two `render` tests confirming columns still line up with wide names and with a combining accent.

One caveat worth flagging: since fetching the official Unicode 16.0 data files wasn't possible (no network access, and the crate intentionally takes no dependencies per `README.md`), the range tables are hand-compiled from memory. Common scripts (Latin/Greek/Cyrillic accents, CJK, kana, Hangul, fullwidth forms, emoji) should be accurate, but some rare historic-script combining marks may be missing or slightly off.
